title: HTML, CSS or JavaScript?
instruction: Structure, look or behaviour? Sort which layer of a website each thing belongs to!

items.why: The tag says it is a heading. That is structure.
The colour of the text is the look.
Reacting to a click is behaviour.
It puts a picture into the page. That is structure.
The size of the font is the look.
Counting while you click is behaviour.
A link is part of the structure of the page.
Where things stand on the page is decided by CSS.
Reacting to a key is behaviour.

debrief: A website has three layers: HTML says what is on the page, CSS how it looks, and JavaScript what the page does when you click or type.
